questions.q: You get a lower grade than your friend on a project you worked hard on. Which response shows emotional maturity?

Downplay your friend's success to others
questions.why: Mature handling means feeling the emotion and still learning from it.

Avoid them until they change, so you don't get snapped at
Complain about them to the group
questions.why: Irritability can hide stress; a private check-in can help.

questions.q: You notice that you procrastinate when you feel anxious about a task. What's an effective strategy?

Tell yourself you work best under pressure
questions.why: Small starts reduce the anxiety that fuels procrastination.

questions.q: During a debate, someone mocks your argument. You feel heat rising. What's the best move?

questions.why: Responding to ideas keeps the debate fair and shows composure.

questions.q: Your sibling is stressed about board exams and snaps at you. What is the most emotionally intelligent response?

questions.why: Seeing the cause of behaviour helps you respond with empathy.

questions.why: Useful lessons can be taken even from poorly delivered feedback.

questions.why: Honest communication helps friendships adapt to change.

questions.why: Recognising that social media is filtered protects self-esteem.

questions.q: A friend confides that they feel hopeless and want to disappear. What should you do?

questions.why: Serious statements about safety need adult help right away.

questions.q: You realise you were wrong in a group decision that went badly. What's the best way to handle it?

questions.why: Taking responsibility builds trust and helps the team move forward.

questions.q: You feel envious of a classmate's success in a competition. Which response reflects high EQ?

questions.why: Respectful, private conversations are more effective.

questions.why: Planning and preparing can ease anticipatory worry.

questions.why: People often need to feel heard before they want solutions.

questions.why: Understanding concerns allows a respectful conversation.

questions.why: Most people are focused on themselves, not your awkward moments.

questions.why: Calm, solution-focused responses help the team recover.

questions.why: Rest is part of performing well, not a weakness.

questions.why: Taking down hurtful content and apologising shows responsibility.

questions.why: Noticing patterns helps you make healthier choices.
